title: save / reopen / stale
observations: Close/reopen works: the reopened session returned the same project uuid, same board/schematic/PCB uuids and the same tree.
Fixture hash was unchanged before/after the whole probe (1 file, sha256 824f6dcc...), proving the read/export probes did not mutate the project.
Save persistence is NOT RUN (authorization); without it a save -> reopen -> readback chain cannot be claimed.
risks: saved:true may still need reopen to prove persistence
stale-read detection is caller-side only at the CLI layer (no staleRisk field seen)
.eprj2 -> .eprj3 conversion on save could change file layout; unmeasured
